status_vectors_schema._note: STATUS-domain conformance vectors per §6: core validity holds; adjudication follows §3.5 vocabulary. Verifiers MUST NOT fold anchoring status into core reject. Populated in rev-1.3+ conformance suite.

fields.envelope_file: relative path to signed envelope JSON
fields.expected_core_validity: boolean — does the composed envelope pass core validity (signatures/canonicalization/seals)?
fields.expected_anchor_status: one of: meets_commitment | short_of_commitment | not_yet_anchored | indeterminate_pending
fields.signer_kids: list[str] — JWKS kids that signed the envelope, in composition order
fields.notes: human-readable disposition and adjudication reference to §3.5
